comments: 'Gos lo tsA ba considers "dkar chung ring mo" to be another name for "gzhon nu tshul khrims" (see [R894SIKE]: 402 (skar chung ring mor grags pa mtshan gzhon nu tshul khrims bya ba des)), but Harter ([2V6H2FBU]: 26) considers them to be two different disciples of Ar Byang chub ye shes.
